title: phleum pratense var. stoloniferum
intro: Phleum pratense var. stoloniferum, commonly known as Creeping Timothy, is a perennial grass plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, which offer various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Timothy are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have analgesic, sedative, and adaptogenic properties. Additionally, it is valued for its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress, and its ability to improve sleep quality and reduce anxiety.
